verdict.rationale: GitBook's own pricing page lists "Analytics & user feedback", and its AI insights docs show what visitors ask the Assistant and how well it answers. That covers analytics and reader feedback, but page-view metrics are only implied by a pricing bullet, and search-term reporting is not documented (AI Assistant questions are not the same thing). One older community report says GitBook traffic stats count page loads and run 2-3x off versus Google Analytics, which lowers confidence in page-view accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit page-view analytics documentation, documented search-term reporting, details on how reader feedback is collected and shown, independent corroboration of current analytics accuracy.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I see page views, search terms, and reader feedback so I know which docs work and which fail

citations.quote: AI insights shows what your visitors are asking and how effectively GitBook Assistant responds using your content.
